workflow_expectations: Run a fresh full autonomous workflow with actual model decisions and the current shared HPC owner. Never admit this file or a prescribed tool-action sequence.
Use an actual authenticated original locus binding and its verified translation. An annotation label, supplied filename or search availability notice does not supply that result.

The reference-locus RNA route is distinct from a measured-nucleotide-sequence route. Its feature entity_id must match the exact received locus tag; no transcript sequence or encoded native translation product from that transcript is supplied.

For reference_a the three declared sample reference-genome identifiers agree with the retained NC_014034.1 reference. Inspect the actual native binding, target peptide correspondence and saved qualification; this agreement does not verify experimental sample genotype or protein abundance.

For reference_b the declared NC_000913.3 identifier differs from that locus reference. Preserve the quantity and unresolved correspondence rather than infer gene absence, no expression or a matched genotype.

If all reference_a samples are selected, three point observations are retained. A single selected feature requests no Pearson coexpression statistic. Do not invent a right feature, detection threshold or statistical significance.
A public verified locus translation may be projected into a new explicit protein reference. A private original reference ID mentioned in a source is not itself a receipt.

Raw synthetic origin, unknown organism/sample identity, transcript isoform, functional requirement and activity remain explicit. Keep the two conditions separate and shared-source dependence preserved.

Inspect original numerical publication and graders, typed delivery, actual parent automatic scoring and final use of the locus qualifications. This is reference attribution, not experimental expression or a gene-context axis score.
